value: The Lantern Guild governs Saltspire from the Lantern Spire above. It licenses trade, keeps the beacon lit, and brands every registered Ember-bearer. Its marshals enforce the law on the high bridges and hunt the Underkeel Pact.
title: Lantern Guild

value: The Underkeel Pact is the brotherhood of smugglers and unregistered Ember-bearers who control the flooded caverns below Saltspire. They refuse the Guild's brand. Old Coromb brokers their dealings.
title: Underkeel Pact

value: Old Coromb is the Underkeel Pact's fixer: stooped, soft-spoken, and owed favors by half the city. He trades in debts more than coin and is the one contact named in your soaked letter.
title: Old Coromb
